usedFor: StoreHippo holds enquiries and orders, and Sangam CRM keeps each person as a lead through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Enquiry” in StoreHippo, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: An enquiry turns into a lead for sales to follow up.

watchOut: “User Updated” fires on every change, so “Create or Update Lead” may run often for one person.
